goal: Prevent node crashes when disk writes fail while storing block and undo data
Ensure running out of disk space triggers diagnostic logs and a clean shutdown
agreement: Strong support for replacing crashes on write errors with clean error handling (ryanofsky)
Supported after encountering the same bug during development (w0xlt)
Approved after enforcing explicit buffer flushes and error discards (maflcko, sedited)
Open question on whether short writes point to a race with disk space checks (maflcko)

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it stops buffered stream write failures from triggering unhandled termination
Stream write errors are cleanly reported instead of re-throwing during destruction

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it turns abrupt node crashes during block storage into graceful shutdowns
Node operators facing full disks get clean diagnostic logs instead of an unhandled crash
